scripts.install-and-build-docker: npm install --save-dev cross-env && npm run docker:build
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development DEBUG=warframestats:* DOCKER=false HTTP=true node ./bin/www
scripts.prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production DEBUG=warframestats:* DOCKER=false HTTP=true node ./bin/www
scripts.docker:rundev: docker run -p 3000:3000 -e NODE_ENV=development -e DOCKER=false -e DEBUG=warframestats:* -e HTTP=true --name app-warstats --rm app-warstats
